title: Pure Digital Bug
summary: Digital Bug cards only, with untagged Insect Xyz Monsters, Links and staples. Digital Bugs are Level 3 LIGHT Insects that can only be Xyz material for Insects, so the Extra Deck holds Insect Xyz Monsters. They trigger when a Bug changes from Attack to Defense Position. Digital Bug Websolder flips a monster to Defense to summon another Bug from the hand. Digital Bug Centibit then summons a Level 3 Insect from the Deck, and Digital Bug LEDybug searches one. Digital Bug Registrider, the newest card, summons itself when you Normal Summon a Level 3 Insect and can make both Level 5 or 7, opening Digital Bug Corebage and Digital Bug Rhinosebus. Digital Bug Scaradiator negates a monster on either turn, and Rhinosebus destroys their highest-DEF monster. Each Bug also passes an effect to the Xyz it becomes. The Main Deck has only five Digital Bug cards, so hand traps and staples fill the rest.
main: Newest: summons itself on a Level 3 Insect Normal Summon; makes both Level 5 or 7.
Flips a monster to Defense to summon a Level 3 Insect from the hand.
Summons a Level 3 Insect from the Deck when flipped to Defense.

Rank 5, or over a Rank 3 or 4 Insect: shuffles a Defense monster into the Deck.
Rank 7, or over a Rank 5 or 6 Insect: destroys their highest-DEF monster.
Untagged Rank 3 Insect: summons an Insect on a position change; negates a monster.
Untagged Rank 3 Insect: pumps your monsters.
